name: KEY ESG (Standalone)
description: KEY ESG gives sustainability teams instant access to their ESG data through natural language queries. Ask questions about your emissions, energy, water, waste, and social metrics without navigating dashboards or running reports manually. Retrieve progress against targets, review action plans, check uploaded policies, and generate board-ready ESG narratives, all from within your workflow. Designed for sustainability managers and their teams, KEY ESG makes ESG data faster to access, easier to interpret, and simpler to act on.

_published_faq.name: How do I add KEY ESG (Standalone) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add KEY ESG (Standalone) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.keyesg.com/standalone/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the KEY ESG (Standalone) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: KEY ESG (Standalone) provides these MCP tools: get_metric_breakdown, get_metric_entity_breakdown, get_metric_value, list_action_plans, list_datapoint_groups, list_entities, list_metrics, list_policies, list_raw_activity_entries, list_raw_carbon_entries, list_targets, and who_am_i.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to KEY ESG (Standalone)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to KEY ESG (Standalone) in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does KEY ESG (Standalone) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: KEY ESG (Standalone) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
KEY ESG (Standalone) is developed by KEY ESG. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
